groups.defect: NewMetricsMiddleware reuses a single middleware instance and overwrites its next pointer, causing races and incorrect delegation chains.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same captured instance and mutable next assignment. Allocating a separate wrapper for each middleware application resolves both reports.

groups.defect: SubscribeStream, PublishStream and RunStream bypass instrumentContext, leaving streaming requests without the promised contextual logging attributes.
groups.rationale: All three report the same omission in the same three streaming methods. The documentation emphasis describes the same coverage gap, and each member already covers the full affected set.
